message.content: In the discussions regarding the community garden, Malfurion Stormrage proposes adding tables for families to enjoy their snacks and picnics. He suggests adding tables near the benches to facilitate gatherings and picnics, which could make the space more comfortable and inviting. Additionally, Malfurion mentions considering shade structures like umbrellas and plants around the seating area to enhance the ambiance and make it more conducive for socializing and leisurely activities.
